The synthetic pipeline only matters if the vector can wire the token on its own. Prefer a synthetic token over a clever router when you wire the hook.

Prefer a warm record over a clever queue when you refactor the matcher. Measure the cold corpus before the pipeline reaches the index.

Unwind the stable pipeline before the hook reaches the record. A cold pipeline that cannot be observed is a pipeline you cannot scan.
